create.name: Becca Tarnas
create.bio:
Becca Tarnas is a scholar and teacher of archetypal cosmology, depth psychology and the imagination. She grew up in Big Sur, California, was educated at the San Francisco Waldorf School and studied environmental studies and theatre at Mount Holyoke College, before taking a master's degree in Philosophy, Cosmology and Consciousness and a PhD in Ecology, Spirituality and Religion at the California Institute of Integral Studies. Her dissertation, The Back of Beyond, compared the 'Red Books' of C.G. Jung and J.R.R. Tolkien as two journeys into the imaginal realm. She is now Assistant Professor in the Philosophy, Cosmology and Consciousness programme at CIIS.

She teaches graduate courses on Jung, archetypal astrology and the research of Stanislav Grof, and lectures widely for Jung societies and institutes, mostly online, on the Red Books, synchronicity and archetypal astrology. She is an editor of Archai: The Journal of Archetypal Cosmology and the author of Journey to the Imaginal Realm, a reader's guide to The Lord of the Rings. She narrated the audiobooks of Grof's The Way of the Psychonaut and When the Impossible Happens, and is writing his biography. She lives in the Sierra Nevada foothills of California with her family.

books.title: Journey to the Imaginal Realm: A Reader's Guide to J. R. R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings
books.author: Becca Tarnas
books.description: A chapter-by-chapter companion to reading The Lord of the Rings, with a biographical introduction to Tolkien. It looks at the story's mythological background and at Tolkien's idea of the imagination as a way into a real, if unseen, world.

free_resources.title: Iridescent Infinity: Participatory Theory and Archetypal Cosmology
free_resources.description: Her essay from Archai issue 5, free as a PDF, bringing participatory theory in philosophy and religion together with archetypal astrology.

free_resources.title: Astrology As A Spiritual Practice
free_resources.description: A short article on approaching archetypal astrology as a contemplative and spiritual practice rather than prediction.

free_resources.title: Eyes That Can See in the Dark: An Astrological Analysis of Toni Wolff & C.G. Jung
free_resources.description: Her free Archai essay reading the relationship and collaboration of Toni Wolff and C.G. Jung through archetypal astrology.

free_resources.title: An Archetypal Glimpse into Teilhard's Evolutionary Vision
free_resources.description: A free Archai essay looking at the life and evolutionary thought of Pierre Teilhard de Chardin through the planetary archetypes.

free_resources.title: Everlasting Concrescence: A Process-Relational Cosmology
free_resources.description: An essay from Archai issue 6, free as a PDF, setting out a process-relational view of the cosmos drawing on Whitehead.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @Becca.Tarnas 2.01K subscribers (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); her site links no other social accounts; WordPress blog shows 1,052 subscribers (not counted) → ~2k → local_hero
flags: Daughter of Richard Tarnas (richard-tarnas.json, same sprint); no videos, books, offerings or free resources overlap with his plan. They have presented together (e.g. Astrology Niagara 2025, Shift's Cosmic Game session), and those joint items were left out.

No current paid offering: her Kosmos Institute Tolkien course ran Sept–Dec 2025, her CIIS courses are graduate courses, and her Shift Network programme starts September 2027 with no page yet. The listing has videos, one book and free essays only.
Her site says she is going on maternity leave and will reply to messages near the end of 2026 or early 2027; the email is her institutional CIIS address.
Her Shift profile names her 'Rebecca Tarnas De Armon'; she publishes as Becca Tarnas (also seen as Becca Segall Tarnas in podcasts).
Her YouTube channel avatar is an older black-and-white photo; same person as the CIIS headshot.
Archai essays are academic; descriptions kept plain.
left_out: Archai issues and Saturn and the Theoretical Foundations of an Emerging Discipline: she is editor or co-editor, not author.

Anthology chapters (Jung's Red Book for Our Time, Psychedelics and Psychotherapy, Re-Enchanting the Academy, How I Found God in Everyone and Everywhere): contributor only; Psychedelics and Psychotherapy also has a health-claim subtitle.
Grof audiobooks: she is narrator, not author.
New moon and solstice forecast videos on her channel: dated.
Dr Becca Tarnas, Archetypes, Synchronicity and Magic (y6ndiAOgUWA): same lecture topic as the Kosmos 2026 recording, left out as a near-duplicate.
The Whole Shebang (H5TknUb92u0) on Footnotes2Plato: a two-way dialogue, not her teaching.
The Mythopoetic Imagination of J.R.R. Tolkien (Kosmos Institute, $333 USD): ran 16 Sept–9 Dec 2025, not listed as on demand.
Frontiers of the Cosmic Game with Stanislav Grof (Shift Network, July–Sept 2026): past, and she was a guest speaker.
